title: True Creeper
description: Prevents creepers from using beneficial potion effects to avoid easy buff exploits from explosion leftovers
body:
True Creeper

True Creeper was created to make creepers feel more dangerous, consistent, and challenging, as they should always have been.

After playing many mod packs, I realized that creepers often became easy and predictable enemies.

This mod modifies several creeper mechanics to make them more reliable threats, while maintaining the settings for different mod packs and balance styles.

What does the mod do?

True Creeper adds multiple configurable mechanics focused on improving creeper behavior and combat pressure.

In the settings, you'll find various options: creepers can avoid receiving beneficial effects from potions (to prevent players from abusing the infinite buff mechanic), spawn naturally as charged creepers, move faster, deal more explosion damage, disable shields when their explosion is blocked, continue detonating once they start, avoid damaging blocks or fallen objects, and ignore the damage from other creepers' explosions.

Each mechanic can be enabled or disabled in the configuration file, allowing mod pack creators and players to fine-tune the experience exactly as they wish.

📂 All configurations are located in modpack\config\everydayxp\truecreeper

Why use True Creeper?

This mod is designed for players and mod pack creators who want creepers to remain relevant throughout the game, rather than being easy to manipulate or counter.

The goal is not only to make creepers stronger, but also more reliable, more threatening, and more interesting in real-world gameplay situations.
